Stop.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$dir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.agents/skills/logs/session'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path (Join-Path $dir ((Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd') + '.log')) -Value ('[' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') + '] [Stop] Session stopped')"

sessionEnd.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$dir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.agents/skills/logs/session'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path (Join-Path $dir ((Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd') + '.log')) -Value ('[' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') + '] [sessionEnd] Session ended')"
